caption: The drawing depicts a single-hand axe with a wooden handle and a large, irregularly shaped metal blade. The handle is light brown with visible wood grain textures, and it curves slightly as it extends downward. The blade is much larger in proportion to the handle, is broad and roughly triangular with a curved cutting edge, and is colored in various shades of brown, indicating metal with surface patina or rust. The joint where the handle meets the blade appears rough, with an uneven transition between the materials. The entire object is set against a plain, off-white background, with no additional objects or decorative elements present in the composition.
title: Pioneeer Broad Axe
